props.gloss_en: [the mishna's clause on] pea pods -- whose is it? it is R' Shimon's, who does not hold [the prohibition of] muktze
a sponge: if it has a handle, one wipes with it
and if not, one does not wipe with it
R' Yehuda, who said: an unintended act is forbidden
in this [case] even R' Shimon concedes -- so the seifa too accords with him
Abaye and Rava both say: R' Shimon concedes in [a case of] 'cut off its head and will it not die?'
those pits of Aramean dates -- it is permitted to move them
since they are fit by virtue of their mother [the date]
Shmuel would move them along with bread
Shmuel said: a person may do all his needs with bread
